Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614234. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614234, exact standard_relation '=', and non-null standard_value. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
